structural_change: s81hd_lane_p9 (STW-S81c-DIE3-LANE 10-22, HEAD lane design (b) successor): the adapter is STACKED hard sub-children (ot_s81hd_lsc_*), each closed with its own local CTS root, replacing p8's single 4,523-sink adapter root along the 583-um strip (TT 163-170 / FF 140-162) and p7f/p6a's pad-chain slice hold (FF -98.9 / -63.0). Parent = closed lane child + sub-children, judged per linked child pair TT+FF; RTL ot_s81hd_lane_{sc6,sc4}.sv cycle-exact vs the current ot_s81hd_lane (eq bench + OVF/RP/SKEW mutants). Ports/widths/edges frozen. Parent floorplan (STW-S81c-DIE4-LANE 10-22): the frozen 898.56-um outline leaves no 43.2-um child-lattice x for the 86.4-wide column with >=20 um to both the lane view (E edge x768.96, itself off the 43.2 lattice) and the E pin face (old x777.6 = 8.6-um channel). Column moved to x789.696 (child_lattice_um 1.728 = lcm(site 0.054, M1-M7 tracks 0.036/0.048/0.064), so every child pin stays on track; children connect PG M5->parent M6, independent of x): lane channel 20.7 um, E core edge 20.3 um. MAIN stack shifted down 8.64 um (row + track aligned; t0 y34.56 ... r1 y509.76) so r1m clears the N core edge by 28.1 um (was 19.4); 21.6-um inter-child channels kept.
